cases.name: Stacia Hollinshead
cases.about: She focused her life on motherhood and her career, her Facebook page indicates. She also had a new boyfriend, Andrew Morris, who told the DeKalb Daily Chronicle, “… I just have so much bitterness and anger right now,” said Morris, 36, of DeKalb. “I was at the happiest I’d ever been in my life, and that’s when I lose her.”She attended Northern Illinois University in DeKalb, Illinois. She received a law degree. She was a residential case manager for Heartland Human services from 2014-2015. She had a bachelor’s degree from Park University in social psychology. She also studied military intelligence at Cochise College.
